purpose: Determine whether completed, cohort-separated evidence supports exactly one new minimum intervention contract for Reliable-DRTP.

required_conditions.replication: At least two adverse DRTP seeds show the same directional signal.
required_conditions.temporal_precedence: The signal is present before task-performance degradation.
required_conditions.paired_utr_specificity: The signal is absent or materially weaker in matched UTR and high-return DRTP controls.
required_conditions.continuous_chain: The evidence connects update/training state to a non-equivalent policy/value/behavior layer and then to task outcome.
required_conditions.minimal_intervention_mapping: One intervention can target the signal without simultaneously changing sampler, PPO, reward, network, or environment.

evidence_records.summary: Conservative failures have no common timing and no repeated PPO/critic precursor absent from controls.
Short-horizon actor and policy divergence patterns differ across adverse seeds and do not yield a DRTP-specific precursor.
The frozen mechanism matrix rejects every criterion for a failure-group-conditioned credit mechanism.
Across 88 alarms, 3 are practically beneficial, 1 harmful, and 84 near-zero; no seed-level selector signal is established.
Both fresh five-seed cohorts systematically lose reward and create new catastrophic seeds; counterfactual critic is not a viable intervention.

decision_rule: Authorize a new algorithm contract only when every required condition is supported by at least one coherent, replicated evidence chain. Otherwise return MECHANISM_DISCOVERY_NO_GO and authorize no new B-line training.
prohibitions: no candidate selection from historical pilots
